It is also noticeable that there are five main stages in the development of the honey bee, from egg to mature adult insect. The life cycle of the honey bee begins when the female adult lays an egg; the female typically lays one or two eggs every 3 days. Between 9 and 10 days later, each egg hatches and the immature insect, or nymph, appears. During the third stage of the life cycle, the nymph grows in size and sheds its skin three times.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: This moulting first takes place 5 days after the egg hatches, then 7 days later, and again another 9 days later. After a total of 30 to 31 days from the start of the cycle, the young adult honey bee emerges from its final moulting stage, and in the space of only 4 days it reaches full maturity. (169 words, band 9)

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The chart compares average figures for temperature and precipitation over the course of a calendar year in Kolkata. It is noticeable that monthly figures for precipitation in Kolkata vary considerably, whereas monthly temperatures remain relatively stable. Rainfall is highest from July to August, while temperatures are highest in April and May. Between the months of January and May, average temperatures in Kolkata rise from their lowest point at around 20°C to a peak of just over 30°C. Average rainfall in the city also rises over the same period, from approximately 20mm of rain in January to 100mm in May.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: While temperatures stay roughly the same for the next four months, the amount of rainfall more than doubles between May and June. Figures for precipitation remain above 250mm from June to September, peaking at around 330mm in July. The final three months of the year see a dramatic fall in precipitation, to a low of about 10mm in December, and a steady drop in temperatures back to the January average. (173 words, band 9)

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The bar charts compare students of different ages in terms of why they are studying and whether they are supported by an employer. It is clear that the proportion of students who study for career purposes is far higher among the younger age groups, while the oldest students are more likely to study for interest. Employer support is more commonly given to younger students. Around 80% of students aged under 26 study to further their careers, whereas only 10% study purely out of interest. The gap between these two proportions narrows as students get older, and the figures for those in their forties are the same, at about 40%.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: Students aged over 49 overwhelmingly study for interest (70%) rather than for professional reasons (less than 20%). Just over 60% of students aged under 26 are supported by their employers. By contrast, the 30-39 age group is the most self-sufficient, with only 30% being given time off and help with fees. The figures rise slightly for students in their forties and for those aged 50 or more. (178 words, band 9)

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The bar chart compares the number of incidents and injuries for every 100 million passenger miles travelled on five different types of public transport in 2002. It is clear that the most incidents and injuries took place on demand-response vehicles. By contrast, commuter rail services recorded by far the lowest figures. A total of 225 incidents and 173 injuries, per 100 million passenger miles travelled, took place on demand-response transport services. These figures were nearly three times as high as those for the second highest category, bus services. There were 76 incidents and 66 people were injured on buses.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: Rail services experienced fewer problems. The number of incidents on light rail trains equalled the figure recorded for buses, but there were significantly fewer injuries, at only 39. Heavy rail services saw lower numbers of such events than light rail services, but commuter rail passengers were even less likely to experience problems. In fact, only 20 incidents and 17 injuries occurred on commuter trains. (165 words, band 9)

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The line graph compares the percentage of people aged 65 or more in three countries over a period of 100 years. It is clear that the proportion of elderly people increases in each country between 1940 and 2040. Japan is expected to see the most dramatic changes in its elderly population. In 1940, around 9% of Americans were aged 65 or over, compared to about 7% of Swedish people and 5% of Japanese people. The proportions of elderly people in the USA and Sweden rose gradually over the next 50 years, reaching just under 15% in 1990. By contrast, the figures for Japan remained below 5% until the early 2000s.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: Looking into the future, a sudden increase in the percentage of elderly people is predicted for Japan, with a jump of over 15% in just 10 years from 2030 to 2040. By 2040, it is thought that around 27% of the Japanese population will be 65 years old or more, while the figures for Sweden and the USA will be slightly lower, at about 25% and 23% respectively. (178 words, band 9)

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The table shows percentages of consumer expenditure for three categories of products and services in five countries in 2002. It is clear that the largest proportion of consumer spending in each country went on food, drinks and tobacco. On the other hand, the leisure/education category has the lowest percentages in the table. Out of the five countries, consumer spending on food, drinks and tobacco was noticeably higher in Turkey, at 32.14%, and Ireland, at nearly 29%.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The proportion of spending on leisure and education was also highest in Turkey, at 4.35%, while expenditure on clothing and footwear was significantly higher in Italy, at 9%, than in any of the other countries. It can be seen that Sweden had the lowest percentages of national consumer expenditure for food/drinks/tobacco and for clothing/footwear, at nearly 16% and just over 5% respectively. Spain had slightly higher figures for these categories, but the lowest figure for leisure/education, at only 1.98%.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The charts compare the amount of water used for agriculture, industry and homes around the world, and water use in Brazil and the Democratic Republic of Congo. It is clear that global water needs rose significantly between 1900 and 2000, and that agriculture accounted for the largest proportion of water used. We can also see that water consumption was considerably higher in Brazil than in the Congo. In 1900, around 500km3 of water was used by the agriculture sector worldwide. The figures for industrial and domestic water consumption stood at around one fifth of that amount.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: By 2000, global water use for agriculture had increased to around 3000km3, industrial water use had risen to just under half that amount, and domestic consumption had reached approximately 500km3. In the year 2000, the populations of Brazil and the Congo were 176 million and 5.2 million respectively. Water consumption per person in Brazil, at 359m3, was much higher than that in the Congo, at only 8m3, and this could be explained by the fact that Brazil had 265 times more irrigated land. (184 words, band 9)

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The bar chart compares the cost of an average house in five major cities over a period of 13 years from 1989. We can see that house prices fell overall between 1990 and 1995, but most of the cities saw rising prices between 1996 and 2002. London experienced by far the greatest changes in house prices over the 13-year period. Over the 5 years after 1989, the cost of average homes in Tokyo and London dropped by around 7%, while New York house prices went down by 5%. By contrast, prices rose by approximately 2% in both Madrid and Frankfurt. Between 1996 and 2002, London house prices jumped to around 12% above the 1989 average.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: Homebuyers in New York also had to pay significantly more, with prices rising to 5% above the 1989 average, but homes in Tokyo remained cheaper than they were in 1989. The cost of an average home in Madrid rose by a further 2%, while prices in Frankfurt remained stable. (165 words)

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The table gives information about poverty rates among six types of household in Australia in the year 1999. It is noticeable that levels of poverty were higher for single people than for couples, and people with children were more likely to be poor than those without. Poverty rates were considerably lower among elderly people. Overall, 11% of Australians, or 1,837,000 people, were living in poverty in 1999. Aged people were the least likely to be poor, with poverty levels of 6% and 4% for single aged people and aged couples respectively.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: Just over one fifth of single parents were living in poverty, whereas only 12% of parents living with a partner were classed as poor. The same pattern can be seen for people with no children: while 19% of single people in this group were living below the poverty line, the figure for couples was much lower, at only 7%. (150 words, band 9)

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The map shows two potential locations (S1 and S2) for a new supermarket in a town called Garlsdon. The main difference between the two sites is that S1 is outside the town, whereas S2 is in the town centre. The sites can also be compared in terms of access by road or rail, and their positions relative to three smaller towns. Looking at the information in more detail, S1 is in the countryside to the northwest of Garlsdon, but it is close to the residential area of the town. S2 is also close to the housing area, which surrounds the town centre.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: There are main roads from Hindon, Bransdon and Cransdon to Garlsdon town centre, but this is a no traffic zone, so there would be no access to S2 by car. By contrast, S1 lies on the main road to Hindon, but it would be more difficult to reach from Bransdon and Cransdon. Both supermarket sites are close to the railway that runs through Garlsdon from Hindon to Cransdon.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The bar chart compares consumer spending on six different items in Germany, Italy, France and Britain. It is clear that British people spent significantly more money than people in the other three countries on all six goods. Of the six items, consumers spent the most money on photographic film. People in Britain spent just over £170,000 on photographic film, which is the highest figure shown on the chart. By contrast, Germans were the lowest overall spenders, with roughly the same figures (just under £150,000) for each of the six products. The figures for spending on toys were the same in both France and Italy, at nearly £160,000.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: However, while French people spent more than Italians on photographic film and CDs, Italians paid out more for personal stereos, tennis racquets and

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: perfumes. The amount spent by French people on tennis racquets, around £145,000, is the lowest figure shown on the chart. The diagrams show how house designs differ according to climate. The most noticeable difference between houses designed for cool and warm climates is in the shape of the roof. The designs also differ with regard to the windows and the use of insulation. We can see that the cool climate house has a high-angled roof, which allows sunlight to enter through the window. By contrast, the roof of the warm climate house has a peak in the middle and roof overhangs to shade the windows.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: Insulation and thermal building materials are used in cool climates to reduce heat loss, whereas insulation and reflective materials are used to keep the heat out in warm climates. Finally, the cool climate house has one window which faces the direction of the sun, while the warm climate house has windows on two sides which are shaded from the sun. By opening the two windows at night, the house designed for warm climates can be ventilated. (162 words, band 9)

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The picture illustrates the way in which water passes from ocean to air to land during the natural process known as the water cycle. Three main stages are shown on the diagram. Ocean water evaporates, falls as rain, and eventually runs back into the oceans again. Beginning at the evaporation stage, we can see that 80% of water vapour in the air comes from the oceans. Heat from the sun causes water to evaporate, and water vapour condenses to form clouds. At the second stage, labelled ‘precipitation’ on the diagram, water falls as rain or snow. At the third stage in the cycle, rainwater may take various paths.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: Some of it may fall into lakes or return to the oceans via ‘surface runoff’. Otherwise, rainwater may filter through the ground, reaching the impervious layer of the earth. Salt water intrusion is shown to take place just before groundwater passes into the oceans to complete the cycle. (156 words, band 9)

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The first picture shows the layout of an art gallery, and the second shows some proposed changes to the gallery space. It is clear that significant changes will be made in terms of the use of floor space in the gallery. There will be a completely new entrance and more space for exhibitions. At present, visitors enter the gallery through doors which lead into a lobby. However, the plan is to move the entrance to the Parkinson Court side of the building, and visitors will walk straight into the exhibition area.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: In place of the lobby and office areas, which are shown on the existing plan, the new gallery plan shows an education area and a small storage area. The permanent exhibition space in the redeveloped gallery will be about twice as large as it is now because it will occupy the area that is now used for temporary exhibitions. There will also be a new room for special exhibitions. This room is shown in red on the existing plan and is not currently part of the gallery. (178 words, band 9)

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The table shows data about the underground rail networks in six major cities. The table compares the six networks in terms of their age, size and the number of people who use them each year. It is clear that the three oldest underground systems are larger and serve significantly more passengers than the newer systems. The London underground is the oldest system, having opened in 1863. It is also the largest system, with 394 kilometres of route. The second largest system, in Paris, is only about half the size of the London underground, with 199 kilometres of route. However, it serves more people per year.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: While only third in terms of size, the Tokyo system is easily the most used, with 1927 million passengers per year. Of the three newer networks, the Washington DC underground is the most extensive, with 126 kilometres of route, compared to only 11 kilometres and 28 kilometres for the Kyoto and Los Angeles systems. The Los Angeles network is the newest, having opened in 2001, while the Kyoto network is the smallest and serves only 45 million passengers per year. (185 words)

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: Cambridge IELTS book 7, page 101: The pie charts compare the amount of electricity produced using five different sources of fuel in two countries over two separate years. Total electricity production increased dramatically from 1980 to 2000 in both Australia and France. While the totals for both countries were similar, there were big differences in the fuel sources used. Coal was used to produce 50 of the total 100 units of electricity in Australia in 1980, rising to 130 out of 170 units in 2000. By contrast, nuclear power became the most important fuel source in France in 2000, producing almost 75% of the country’s electricity.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: Australia depended on hydro power for just under 25% of its electricity in both years, but the amount of electricity produced using this type of power fell from 5 to only 2 units in France. Oil, on the other hand, remained a relatively important fuel source in France, but its use declined in Australia. Both countries relied on natural gas for electricity production significantly more in 1980 than in 2000. (170 words)

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The chart gives information about UK immigration, emigration and net migration between 1999 and 2008. Both immigration and emigration rates rose over the period shown, but the figures for immigration were significantly higher. Net migration peaked in 2004 and 2007. In 1999, over 450,000 people came to live in the UK, while the number of people who emigrated stood at just under 300,000. The figure for net migration was around 160,000, and it remained at a similar level until 2003. From 1999 to 2004, the immigration rate rose by nearly 150,000 people, but there was a much smaller rise in emigration.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: Net migration peaked at almost 250,000 people in 2004. After 2004, the rate of immigration remained high, but the number of people emigrating fluctuated. Emigration fell suddenly in 2007, before peaking at about 420,000 people in 2008. As a result, the net migration figure rose to around 240,000 in 2007, but fell back to around 160,000 in 2008.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: It is clear from the charts that the figures for developed countries are much higher than those for developing nations. Also, the charts show an overall increase in participation in education and science from 1980 to 1990. People in developing nations attended school for an average of around 3 years, with only a slight increase in years of schooling from 1980 to 1990. On the other hand, the figure for industrialised countries rose from nearly 9 years of schooling in 1980 to nearly 11 years in 1990. From 1980 to 1990, the number of scientists and technicians in industrialised countries almost doubled to about 70 per 1000 people.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: Spending on research and development also saw rapid growth in these countries, reaching $350 billion in 1990. By contrast, the number of science workers in developing countries remained below 20 per 1000 people, and research spending fell from about $50 billion to only $25 billion. (187 words)

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The diagram below shows how the Australian Bureau of Meteorology collects up-to-the-minute information on the weather in order to produce reliable forecasts. The figure illustrates the process used by the Australian Bureau of Meteorology to forecast the weather. There are four stages in the process, beginning with the collection of information about the weather. This information is then analysed, prepared for presentation, and finally broadcast to the public. Looking at the first and second stages of the process, there are three ways of collecting weather data and three ways of analysing it.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: Firstly, incoming information can be received by satellite and presented for analysis as a satellite photo. The same data can also be passed to a radar station and presented on a radar screen or synoptic chart. Secondly, incoming information may be collected directly by radar and analysed on a radar screen or synoptic chart. Finally, drifting buoys also receive data which can be

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: shown on a synoptic chart. At the third stage of the process, the weather broadcast is prepared on computers. Finally, it is delivered to the public on television, on the radio, or as a recorded telephone announcement. The line graph compares the percentage of people in three countries who used the Internet between 1999 and 2009. It is clear that the proportion of the population who used the Internet increased in each country over the period shown. Overall, a much larger percentage of Canadians and Americans had access to the Internet in comparison with Mexicans, and Canada experienced the fastest growth in Internet usage.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: In 1999, the proportion of people using the Internet in the USA was about 20%. The figures for Canada and Mexico were lower, at about 10% and 5% respectively. In 2005, Internet usage in both the USA and Canada rose to around 70% of the population, while the figure for Mexico reached just over 25%. By 2009, the percentage of Internet users was highest in Canada. Almost 100% of Canadians used the Internet, compared to about 80% of Americans and only 40% of Mexicans.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: The map shows the growth of a village called Chorleywood between 1868 and 1994. It is clear that the village grew as the transport infrastructure was improved. Four periods of development are shown on the map, and each of the populated areas is near to the main roads, the railway or the motorway. From 1868 to 1883, Chorleywood covered a small area next to one of the main roads. Chorleywood Park and Golf Course is now located next to this original village area. The village grew along the main road to the south between 1883 and 1922, and in 1909 a railway line was built crossing this area from west to east.

items.title: Simon 小作文范文 22 篇
items.content: Chorleywood station is in this part of the village. The expansion of Chorleywood continued to the east and west alongside the railway line until 1970. At that time, a motorway was built to the east of the village, and from 1970 to 1994, further development of the village took place around motorway intersections with the railway and one of the main roads.

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: Simon语料库中英文 Ideas for IELTS topics Who is this book for? Many students have no ideas or opinions about IETLS writing topics. Even if your grammar is perfect, you will not get a high IELTS score if you do not know what to write. This book is for students who want to go into the writing exam feeling confident that they have excellent ideas, opinions and vocabulary for as many topics as possible How do you get an IELTS score of 7 or higher? The key to a high score is not grammar, it is not your use of words like “moreover” or “in addition”, and it is not your use of phrases like “this is controversial issue nowadays” .

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: To get a high score you need to use good “topic language” (words and phrases that are related to the question topic). You need good ideas in order to answer the question well. How should you prepare for IELTS writing task 2? There is an enormous amount of advice on my website ielts-simon.com. Here is a summary of what I suggest: - Spend more time preparing than testing When you test yourself, you find out what your level is, but you do not learn anything new. You will not improve if you only write test essays.

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: Before writing an essay, study the topic and prepare your ideas, opinions and vocabulary. - Steal my ideas If you only use the vocabulary that you already know, you will not learn anything new, and you will not improve. Practise linking my topic ideas together to write “perfect essays” . See the website for examples of how to do this. - Use this book together with the website The website ielts-simon.com contains lessons and videos that show you how to use the ideas from this book. You can speak to me there if you have any questions.

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: Advertising广告 广告的好处 Companies need to tell customers about their products 公司需要告诉顾客他们的产品 Advertisements inform us about the choices we have 广告告诉我们我们所拥有的选择 Advertising is a creative industry that employs many people 广告是一个创造性的产业,雇佣了很多人 Without advertising we would have less choice 没有广告,我们的选择就少了 Without advertising there would be higher unemployment 没有广告就会有更高的失业率 Advertising is a form of modern art 广告是现代艺术的一种形式 People enjoy adverts 人们喜欢广告 Advertising manipulates people 广告操纵人 Negatives of Advertising广告的负面影响 It aims to persuade people that buying a product will make them happier 它的目的是说服人们购买某种产品会让他们更快乐 Advertisers focus on selling a brand image 广告商专注于推销品牌形象 They use glamorous, successful people 他们使用迷人的成功人士 We now live in a consumer culture 我们现在生活在消费文化中 We are persuaded to follow the latest trend 我们被说服跟随最新的潮流 We are encouraged to associate certain brands with a higher status 我们被鼓励将某些品牌与更高的地位联系起来 Advertisers often aim their marketing at children 广告商经常把他们的营销目标对准儿童 Children can easily be influenced by advertisements.

items.content: Children put pressure on parents to buy them things 孩子给父母买东西的压力 Advertising should be regulated 广告应该受到管 Opinions about Advertising对广告的看法 Advertising aimed at children should be controlled or even banned 针对儿童的广告应该被控制甚至禁止 Unhealthy foods should not be marketed in a way that attracts children 不健康食品的营销方式不应该吸引儿童 Products that can be risk to healthy should display warnings 可能危害健康的产品应该显示警告 In some countries it is illegal to advertise cigarettes on television 在一些国家,在电视上做香烟广告是违法的 Warnings must be displayed on cigarette packets 警告必须显示在烟盒上 However, advertising is necessary in free market economies 然而,广告在自由市场经济中是必要的 It creates demand for products 它创造了对产品的需求 Governments should only censor false information or products that are harmful 政府应该只审查虚假信息或有害的产品 Animals are used in important scientific research 动物被用于重要的科学研 2.

items.content: They are responsible for cooking, cleaning and paying bills 他们负责做饭、打扫卫生和付账单 They will learn a foreign language 他们将学习一门外语 Drawback of studying abroad出国留学的缺点 Living and studying abroad can be difficult 在国外生活和学习可能会很困难 Students have problems with paperwork such as visa applications 学生们在签证申请等文书工作上存在问题 The language barrier can be a problem 语言障碍可能是个问题 Students have to find accommodation and pay bills 学生们必须寻找住宿和支付账单 Studying in a foreign language is challenging 学习一门外语是具有挑战性的 Living alone in an unfamiliar culture can cause homesickness 独自生活在陌生的文化中会引起思乡之情 Technology in Education: Advantages教育技术:优势 Technology is a powerful tool to engage students 科技是吸引学生的有力工具 Technology can make lessons much more interesting 科技可以让课程变得更有趣 Students can do research using online resources 学生可以利用在线资源做研究 Students can study at their own place 学生可以在自己的地方学习 Adults can take distance learning courses 成年人可以参加远程学习课程 Students can study whenever and wherever they want 学生可以随时随地学习 Students also learn skills which are useful for their future jobs 学生们还学习了对他们未来工作有用的技能 For example, they learn to write reports using a word processor 例如,他们学习用文字处理器写报告 Technology in Education: Disadvantages教育中的技术:缺点 People rely too much on computers

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: 人们太依赖电脑了 Young learners do not become proficient in some basic skills 年轻的学习者在一些基本技能上不熟练 They use word processors and spelling may suffer 他们使用文字处理器,拼写可能会受到影响 People should be able to write a letter by hand 人们应该能够用手写信 Technology is no substitute for a real teacher 科技不能代替真正的老师 Learners need a structured course 学习者需要结构化的课程 An experienced teacher knows what materials to choose 一个有经验的老师知道该选择什么材料 Computers are expensive to maintain and can be unreliable 计算机维护费用昂贵,而且可能不可靠 Technology in Education: Opinion教育中的技术:观点 Institutions should supplement traditional teaching with the use of technology 学校应该利用科技来补充传统教学 Technology is part of everyday life 科技是日常生活的一部分 It can enhance a teacher’s lessons 它可以提高教师的教学效果 Students can use online resources to help with homework 学生可以使用在线资源来帮助完成家庭作业 Students must still learn to write by hand 学生们还必须学习手写 They should still use traditional sources of information such as books 他们仍然应该使用传统的信息来源,如书籍 Education in Developing countries: Problems发展中国家的教育:问题 Children often have to work from an early age 孩子们往往从小就不得不工作 There are no schools in many areas 许多地区没有学校 Families do not have access to books or computers 家庭没有书本和电脑 Literacy rates are often low 识字率通常很低 People in developing countries need knowledge and skills

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: 发展中国家的人民需要知识和技能 Education is the key to improving the economy of these countries 教育是改善这些国家经济的关键 Education in developing countries: solutions 发展中国家的教育:解决方案 Developed countries could help developing nations by providing money 发达国家可以通过提供资金来帮助发展中国家 They could invest in schools and technology 他们可以投资学校和科技 They could supply the funds to build schools and pay for teachers 他们可以提供建造学校和支付教师的资金 Children need to have access to free schooling 孩子们需要接受免费教育 Computer equipment could be donated 电脑设备可以捐赠 The Internet can expose students to a world of knowledge and information 互联网可以让学生接触到一个知识和信息的世界 Governments should make education compulsory for all children 政府应该让所有的孩子都接受义务教育 They should encourage parents to send their children to school 他们应该鼓励父母送孩子上学 Governments of developed and developing countries must work together 发达国家和发展中国家的政府必须共同努力 Higher education: Advantages (also see “benefits of education”) 高等教育:优势(参见“教育的好处”) There are many benefits to going to university 上大学有很多好处 A degree can open the door to better employment prospects 学位可以为更好的就业前景打开大门 Economies are becoming increasingly knowledge-based 经济越来越以知识为基础 Most jobs require specific knowledge and skills 大多数工作都需要特定的知识和技能 Skilled workers are needed for sectors such as information technology and engineering 信息技术和工程等行业需要熟练工人 Repetitive manual jobs are now done by machine

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: 重复的体力劳动现在由机器来完成 Many factories have moved to developing countries 许多工厂已迁往发展中国家 Higher education: Disadvantages高等教育:劣势 A healthy economy needs a wide range of workers 健康的经济需要各行各业的工人 Some manual workers will always be needed 一些体力劳动者是永远需要的 A university degree is not necessary for many service professions 许多服务行业并不需要大学学位 Practical training is more important in some industries 在某些行业,实践培训更为重要 In the UK, for example, there is currently a shortage of plumbers 例如,在英国,目前水管工短缺 Their services are therefore becoming more and more expensive 因此,他们的服务变得越来越昂贵 Advantage of Home-schooling在家上学的好处 Some parents decide to educate their children at home 有些父母决定在家里教育他们的孩子 Some families live in isolated areas with poor transport 一些家庭住在交通不便的偏远地区 Other parents are not satisfied with local schools 其他家长对当地学校不满意 Parents can respond to what their children need and how they learn best 父母可以回应他们的孩子需要什么,以及他们如何学得最好 One-to-one lessons allow much faster progress 一对一的课程可以让你进步得更快 The child can work at his or her own pace 孩子可以按照自己的节奏学习 Discipline problems are avoided by home-schooling 家庭教育避免了纪律问题 Disadvantages of home-schooling在家上学的缺点 Most parents do not have the time to educate their children at home 大多数父母没有时间在家教育他们的孩子 One parent would need to give up work

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: 父母中的一方需要放弃工作 School subjects are normally taught by up to ten different teachers 学校科目通常由多达10位不同的老师教授 Most parents do not have the necessary knowledge or resources 大多数父母没有必要的知识或资源 Private tutors are expensive 私人教师很贵 Children will miss out on the social experience that school offers 孩子们将错过学校提供的社会经验 At school, children learn how to get on with each other 在学校里,孩子们学习如何与他人相处 Home-schooled children may lack social skills 在家上学的孩子可能缺乏社交技能 Schools offer a better overall educational experience 学校提供更好的整体教育体验 Bad behavior in schools: causes学校不良行为:原因 Bad behavior is due to a lack of structure and discipline 不良行为是由于缺乏结构和纪律 There are too many children in some classes 有些班级的孩子太多了 Large classes are difficult to manage 大班很难管理 May disruptive students come from an unstable family background 捣乱的学生可能来自不稳定的家庭背景 Other parents are too lenient and spoil their children 有些父母太过宽容,溺爱孩子 Some children are used to getting whatever they want 有些孩子习惯于得到他们想要的任何东西 Schools can do very little if they are not supported by parents 如果没有家长的支持,学校将无能为力 Bad behavior in schools: solutions学校不良行为:解决办法 Schools need a clear code of conduct 学校需要明确的行为准则 Schools need a clear set of rules about behavior 学校需要一套明确的行为规范 They need to create a positive working atmosphere 他们需要创造一个积极的工作氛围

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: Teachers must have the power to punish disruptive students 教师必须有权惩罚捣乱的学生 Schools should remove difficult children from lessons 学校应该让有困难的孩子不去上课 Schools need to work closely with parents 学校需要与家长密切合作 Discipline could be lacking at home 家里可能缺乏纪律 Parents must support the school rules 家长必须支持校规 They should take responsibility for their children’s behavior 他们应该对孩子的行为负责 Corporal Punishment: Opinion体罚:意见 Corporal Punishment is not a good idea 体罚不是个好主意 Physical punishment is a way of controlling children using fear 体罚是一种利用恐惧来控制孩子的方法 This does not promote trust between adults and children 这不利于促进成人和儿童之间的信任 Children who are punished physically may become shy or resentful 受到体罚的孩子可能会变得害羞或怨恨 Corporal punishment creates an atmosphere of fear and anger 体罚创造了一种恐惧和愤怒的氛围 Single Sex Education: Advantages单性别教育:优势 Some people believe that male and female students should go to separate schools 有些人认为男女学生应该去不同的学校 This is often for religious or cultural reasons 这通常是由于宗教或文化原因 Discipline problems might be avoided by separating boys and girls 把男孩和女孩分开可能会避免纪律问题 Boys and girls may learn in different ways and have different needs 男孩和女孩可能以不同的方式学习,有不同的需求 Student at single-sex schools often get better exam grades.

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: 单性别学校的学生通常在考试中取得更好的成绩。 Single-sex Education: Disadvantages单性别教育:缺点 Separating boys and girls is unnecessary

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: 把男孩和女孩分开是没有必要的 It is unhealthy in terms of children’s social development 就儿童的社会发展而言,这是不健康的 Many coeducational schools are extremely successful 许多男女同校的学校都非常成功 A mixed-sex environment is more representative of real life 男女混合的环境更能代表现实生活 Coeducational schools provide children with better social skills for adult life 男女同校的学校为孩子们提供了更好的社交技能,以适应成年生活 Advantages of Streaming (grouping children according to ability) 分班的优势(根据能力分组) Some schools separate students according to their academic ability 有些学校根据学业能力把学生分开 Teachers can work at the right speed for their students 教师可以以适当的速度为学生工作 Teachers can plan more suitable lessons 教师可以计划更合适的课程 High-level groups may progress faster 高级别小组可能进展更快 Lower level groups can benefits from a slower pace 较低水平的小组可以从较慢的节奏中受益 Some teachers and parents support streaming for these reasons 由于这些原因,一些老师和家长支持流媒体 Disadvantages of Streaming流媒体的缺点 Grouping by ability may have a negative impact on students 按能力分组可能会对学生产生负面影响孩子们不希望被认为不如别人聪明 Children do not want to be seen as less intelligent than others 孩子们不希望被认为不如别人聪明 Streaming could damage students’ self esteem 流媒体可能会损害学生的自尊 They may lose motivation 他们可能会失去动力 Students from wealthier families tend to be better prepared 来自富裕家庭的学生往往准备得更好 Children from poorer families may receive less support from parents 贫困家庭的孩子从父母那里得到的支持可能更少 Mixed ability classes encourage everyone to achieve their potential .
